page.layout: One page of text: a centred block of running text at the top, then the closing line "FINIS II. LIBRI." in spaced capitals, then a gathering mark at the right, then a woodcut ornament. Running head and page number at the top.

main_text.p: Rhetorica mutuentur. Atque ut de nostra hac dicamus, ordinem ac certam rationem à Dialectica recte accipies: quare licet jam ad cetera quæ consequuntur, pergamus.

page.notes: The "N 3" gathering mark stands at the right of the page, above the ornament, not at the foot. The woodcut ornament (a mask with scrolls and tassels) is not text and is not transcribed. Small specks and stains on the page are ignored. The first paragraph has no printed indent; the lines are centred, so it is set as one block. Long s is written as plain s throughout: "noftra" is read as "nostra" and "confequuntur" as "consequuntur".
